appraisal_events.evidence: elle n'y avait sans doute pas pensé une fois ... j'appris un absurde mariage d'amour qu'elle fit ... je me mis à sangloter ... pareil aux Juifs qui se couvraient la tête de cendres dans le deuil.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's despair deepens into open grief as he realizes Mme de Stermaria likely never thought of their dinner at all, being already absorbed in the love affair that would lead to her marriage; he ends up sobbing alone into a pile of rolled carpets.

status_effects.explanation: His disappointment intensifies into visible grief, weeping alone as he grasps that she had not shared even a fraction of the anticipation he had invested all week.
With his parents' imminent return he recognizes his seclusion is beginning, shutting him out of the freer evenings he had been living and confining him to family meals.
